name: B10-0115/2024 (Renew) – The cases of unjustly imprisoned Uyghurs in China, notably Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of unjustly imprisoned Uyghurs in China, notably Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns China's persecution of Uyghurs and other minorities and calls their treatment crimes against humanity and genocide. It asks China to free Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas, both jailed, and many other detained activists, and to let them see family, lawyers and doctors. It wants an independent international investigation into abuses in Xinjiang, new European Union sanctions on Chinese officials responsible, and United Nations follow-up. This is the Parliament's opinion and request; it does not itself change any law.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament only states demands and asks for sanctions and an investigation.
- It concerns jailed Uyghurs and activists, their families, and Chinese officials who could be sanctioned.
- Next, the text goes to European Union bodies, China and the United Nations; no action is guaranteed.
